detail.title: Reward Scalarization and Multi-Objective Assumptions in Reinforcement Learning
detail.summary: Examines how scalarization functions, such as thresholded lexicographic ordering, shape action selection and potential failure modes in multi-objective reinforcement learning.
detail.reason: Synthesizing collected evidence for the synthesis-ready project on reward scalarization assumptions.
